title: FrameworkStructure
description: Framework base Archetype for Structure — the foundational dynamic aggregate. Inherits gsm/Structure through the top-level $ref and composes the catalogue-wide FrameworkAscription facet through allOf. Every non-Archetype Structure statement distributed by this repository MUST be typed by this Archetype or one of its descendants, never directly by gsm/Structure, which carries no framework membership vocabulary. Source: gsm-frameworks (framework foundation).
